visible_condition: Dusty casing with signs of wear
hidden_risks: Whether the floppy disk drive is functional
Responsiveness and contact issues of keys and buttons
Condition of internal speakers and audio output ports
Whether a compatible power adapter is included
response.best_proof: Photo of the keyboard powered on with the LCD screen actively displaying normal interface text
response.failure_mode: Assuming full functionality of electronics, keys, and floppy drive based solely on external appearance and unverified seller claims.
